title: Mill Hill Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in care, and local hazard advice for Mill Hill and NW7.
content:
Life-threatening emergencies are always 999 first. For non-life-threatening urgent advice, call NHS 111.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Barnet Hospital, Wellhouse Lane, Barnet EN5 3DJ. From Mill Hill Broadway station: ~4 miles north-east via A1 and A411; take bus 251 towards Edgware/Totteridge or bus 107 from Edgware.
- Royal Free Hospital, Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG (24-hour A&E). From Mill Hill Broadway: ~6 miles south via A41; or Thameslink train south to West Hampstead and connecting bus.
- St Mary's Hospital, Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY (Nearest Major Trauma Centre). Accessible via A41 south into central London.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Edgware Community Hospital UTC, Burnt Oak Broadway, Edgware HA8 0AD. Open daily 08:00–22:00. From Mill Hill Broadway: ~20 min walk (approx. 1 mile) west along Station Road and Hale Lane, or bus 221 / 240 west to Edgware.

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The Silk Stream and Dean's Brook flow through western Mill Hill towards the Welsh Harp reservoir, creating localized surface water and river flood risks along low-lying terrain near Edgware and Burnt Oak borders.
- Major trunk roads (M1 motorway, A1 Watford Way, and A41) divide the area and may become congested or blocked during severe incidents.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Pharmacies, convenience stores, and supermarkets along The Broadway (Mill Hill Broadway) and Apex Corner (A41/A1 junction) provide bottled water, over-the-counter medication, and basic first-aid supplies during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
